run_music_translation_inference: run music translation inference on wav or h5 audio files using a WaveNet checkpoint
run_batch_audio_translation: run batch audio translation with a specified batch size and split size on multiple files
run_python_generator_mode: run music translation using the python WavenetGenerator instead of the NVWavenetGenerator
extract_decoder_id: extract the decoder ID integer from a checkpoint file path string
parse_inference_args: parse command line arguments for checkpoint path, input files, output directory, and generation parameters
